title: ISRAEL - GOD'S PROPHETIC TIME CLOCK

blocks.text: “We see in the Bible that God’s prophetic promises are true and that certain events would occur just before He returned!” Isa. 27:6 – Isa. 35:1-2, “Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit! – The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose! It shall blossom abundantly!” – And this is just exactly what has happened! . . . “After two thousand years the Jews have turned their land into a Garden of Eden nearly! Besides their food products, their flowers are among the most beautiful in the world that they ship to Europe!” – “Only the Lord could foresee what is making part of this possible with modern technology!” – “They use computerized irrigation systems. Even in the Negev Desert they produce abundance!”

Let us print a news report for your insight. “A computer does the irrigation! It is amazingly sophisticated. Each field has a tensiometer in the soil that constantly measures the moisture!” – “Each area has a gauge that tells wind direction, wind speed and humidity! – The computer knows what is planted in each field and its stage of maturity! – It figures that the onions, tomatoes, etc. need so many minutes of water. Automatically the valves are turned on and off! – It can decide to inject a little fertilizer in the irrigation water automatically!” – “And with Israel back in the land she is being restored and prepared for the millennium!” . . . “And then they will grow crops that they have never dreamed of, even greater than all times! . . . The real Messiah is coming soon!”

We have a beautiful prophetic Scripture that fits the above, a very Capstoning of the subject! – Ps. 102:16, “when the Lord shall build up Zion (Jerusalem area) He shall appear in His glory! Amen.” “And Israel has built some beautiful new buildings surrounding the city! – But before Israel enters the millennium she must suffer much, a day of Jacob’s trouble, none shall ever be like it! – Much of their beautiful restoration will be destroyed!” Joel 2:3, “A fire devoureth before them and behind them a flame burneth; the land is as the Garden of Eden before them; and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them!” – “But after the battle the Lord of Hosts has promised to cleanse the land of all radiation and then Israel will have the wealth of the world and the most beautiful land the world has ever seen in production!” (Isa. 60:3-16) “Of course many Scriptures confirm this, and Isa. 35:1-2 takes this in consideration also!”

“As we know since 1945 some vital and major events have taken place such as, we were swept into the Atomic Age! (Luke 21:26) – “Israel recovers the old city as the times of the Gentiles are fulfilling!” (verse 24) – “The restoration of the state of Israel in 1948!” – “So the next thing for Israel to watch in the immediate future is the rise of the false messiah! – One more prophetic significance is the building of the Jewish Temple, some believe that it is the great synagogue that is now being constructed! If it is not, then one will be built soon!” (Rev. 11:1-2 – II Thess. 2:4 – Dan. 11:45) – “The anti-Christ could also be part Jewish and Gentile!” – This is not for certain, but the Scriptures may give a clue, Dan. 11:37, “Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers!” . . . “So we may look for a Roman prince out of the revived Roman Empire who could have Jewish blood!”

“Besides the Jews returning to their homeland after 2,000 years, the Bible gives other signs that would occur in conjunction with this! – Nation shall rise against nation. (Matt. 24:7) Earthquakes, famines and pestilences! – Knowledge shall be increased. (Dan 12:4) Evil men shall wax worse and worse!” (II Tim. 3:13) – “And if we really want to know how close the coming of the Lord is, just before He returned we were to see this Scripture fulfilling! – The falling away from the very faith!” (I Tim. 4:1-2) – “And have you noticed all around you, seemingly for no reason at all people are just giving up their faith. But God is gathering new ones each day for the true elect!” – “And others the Scriptures say, would not endure sound doctrine at all!” (II Tim. 4:2-4) – “The Bible says people would have a form of godliness, but deny the true power!” Also scoffers who don’t care to hear of the second coming of Jesus! (II Peter 3:3-4, 10) . . . And with this, signs in the sun, moon, stars; distress of nations: men’s hearts failing them for fear! (Luke 21:25-27) And we could go on and on, proving by prophetic events that the age is closing swiftly!”

“Even though according to Dan. chap 12, that there are some bleak days ahead for Israel, we are made to know that everything will turn out alright in the end concerning the ‘true seed’ of Israel!” (Rev. chap. 7) – “We would like to close with this wonderful promise that shows God will establish His kingdom and give victory to His own!” – Micah, chap. 4, read verses 1 and 3 and we will list verse 2, “And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways; and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem!” . . . “Behold, saith the Lord of Hosts, Israel’s king shall surely come and this prophecy will be fulfilled to the very last word! Amen!” – “Let’s work and give all we can in the days ahead for surely time is running out. This is our last chance to publish the gospel!”
